ruleOrigin: Added product interpretations grounded in the supplied manual; not verbatim source metadata or implemented completion rules.

rules.catalog-reference: Catalog/source-status links are references, not a new assignment.
rules.weekly-overview: Weekly resource lists are overview references; explicit optional clauses take priority.
rules.daily-assignment: A named resource in Uči / pročitaj is assigned reading of the named section only (p0025). No external course-wide completion is implied.
rules.as-needed-reference: po potrebi/as reference/preview or personal notes remain supporting references; not mandatory external coursework.
rules.explicit-optional: An explicit optional clause, or its same-provider weekly optional designation, is optional.
rules.alternative-choice: An explicit alternative is conditional on the selected route; do not require both sources.
rules.used-topics-condition: Only the topics used in the learner project are applicable; do not prescribe the whole course/docs.
rules.problem-set-primary: The selected problem-set registry is the assigned source; the general CS50 parent is reference navigation.
rules.manual-instruction: This record preserves a source instruction/review topic, not a newly supplied external learning link.
rules.unspecified-documentation: Documentation is specified but its provider/library is not; retain this uncertainty.
rules.resource-restriction: Preserve the exact no-new-resource/no-tutorial/first-120-minutes restriction; never turn it into a resource requirement.

raw.assignedText: The Odin Project Foundations: Aktuelni Foundations redosled uključuje JS basics, Problem Solving, Understanding Errors, Rock Paper Scissors, Clean Code, Loops/Arrays, DOM/Events, Etch-a-Sketch, Object Basics i Calculator. Izvor

The Odin Project JavaScript: Aktuelni JS course uključuje Library, Tic Tac Toe, Classes, ES6 Modules, npm, Webpack, Todo, async/APIs/Weather, testing, recursion, complexity i data structures/algorithms projekte. Izvor

CS50x 2026: Aktuelne nedelje: Scratch, C, Arrays, Algorithms, Memory, Data Structures, Python, SQL, HTML/CSS/JS, Flask i završetak; kurs eksplicitno cilja algorithmic thinking i efficient problem solving. Izvor

Full Stack Open: Aktuelni kurs je kontinuiran (više nema striktno godišnjih verzija); fokus React + REST API/Node, uz testing, baze, auth i dodatne module. Part 0 navodi da se očekuju dobre programerske veštine, web/database osnove i Git, zbog čega je namerno kasno u ovom planu. Izvor
Exercism JavaScript: Track trenutno oglašava 159 vežbi i 37 JavaScript koncepata, besplatno. Izvor
MDN JavaScript Guide: Aktuelni Guide obuhvata grammar/types, control flow, loops, functions, collections, objects, classes, promises, modules i advanced topics. Izvor
javascript.info: Aktuelni tutorial ide od fundamentals preko objects/data types/advanced functions do promises, modules i browser tema. Izvor

evidence.exactText: Čitaj tačno navedeni resurs.
The Odin Project — Foundations
Otvori
Nedelje 1–6. Problem solving, errors, JS basics, DOM, Rock Paper Scissors, Etch-a-Sketch, Calculator.
The Odin Project — JavaScript
Otvori
Nedelje 7–12. Library, Tic Tac Toe, modules/npm/bundling, Todo, async/APIs/Weather, testing, recursion/complexity.
Otvori
Nedelje 13–19. Computational thinking, C, arrays, algorithms, memory, data structures, Python, SQL.
CS50x Problem Sets
Otvori
Koristi uz odgovarajuću CS50 nedelju; obavezno poštuj njihovu aktuelnu academic-honesty/AI politiku.
Full Stack Open
Otvori
Nedelje 20–25. React, server communication, Node/Express, baze, testing, auth, end-to-end.
Exercism — JavaScript
Otvori
Od prve nedelje kao dopunski problem gym. Trenutni track ima 159 vežbi / 37 koncepata.
MDN JavaScript Guide
Otvori
Reference za preciznu JS semantiku i browser API-je.
javascript.info
Otvori
Glavni čitljivi JS tutorial/reference: fundamentals → objects → advanced functions → promises/modules/browser.
React Learn
Otvori
Reference tokom FSO kada treba razjasniti React mental model.
Node.js Docs
Otvori
Reference za Node API, ne kurs.
Pro Git
Otvori
Besplatna knjiga/reference za Git; koristi po potrebi.
PostgreSQL Tutorial
Otvori
Reference za SQL/PostgreSQL tokom nedelje 19 i capstone-a ako biraš Postgres.
